### MIME (RFC 2045-2049)

*  "Multipurpose Internet Mail Extensions"
<hr/>
*  non-ASCII, non-text message data
*  non-ASCII message headers
*  attachments

### Content-Transfer-Encoding {.smaller}

*  mail servers may not support sending non-ASCII data, very long lines
   *  need encode data for transport; decode on receipt
*  Content-Transfer-Encoding header:
   *  "7bit"
      *  ASCII data, sent unchanged
   *  "8bit", "binary"
      *  non-ASCII data, sent unchanged
      *  should only be selected if we trust mail transport to handle this
   *  "quoted-printable"
      *  `\xAB`→`=AB`; `=`→`=3D`, `\r\n`→`=0D=0A`
      *  newlines (not part of original data) inserted if lines more than 76 characters long
   *  "base64"
      *  convert to base-64 number, using A-Za-z0-9+/ to represent "digits",
      *  `=` for padding

### headers with non-ASCII

*  headers may need non-ASCII data
   *  can't rely on servers supporting this...
   *  so need to hide non-ASCII data within ASCII data
*  <pre>=?<i>charset</i>?Q?<i>quoted-printable data</i>?</pre>
*  <pre>=?<i>charset</i>?B?<i>base 64data</i>?</pre>
<hr/>
*  example: `Subject: =?UTF-8?Q?=C2=BC?= is a fraction`
    *  `Subject: ¼ is a fraction`

### Content-Types

*  similar to HTTP; examples:
   *  `text/plain; charset="utf-8"`
   *  `text/html; charset="utf-8"`
   *  `text/rtf; charset="iso-8859-1"`
*  `multipart/*` types:
   *   multipart/mixed --- multiple independent things (e.g. body + attachments)
   *   multipart/alternative --- two+ versions (e.g. text + HTML)

### example {.smaller .longcode}

```
Content-Type: multipart/mixed; boundary="=-i7xTKF0wGtypzrrxHBJS"
MIME-Version: 1.0

--=-i7xTKF0wGtypzrrxHBJS
Content-Type: text/plain
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 7bit

This is a test message.

--=-i7xTKF0wGtypzrrxHBJS
Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="attachment.txt"
Content-Type: text/plain; name="attachment.txt"; charset="UTF-8"
Content-Transfer-Encoding: base64

VGhpcyBpcyBhIHRlc3QgYXR0YWNobWVudC4K

--=-i7xTKF0wGtypzrrxHBJS
Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="attachment2.txt"
Content-Transfer-Encoding: base64
Content-Type: text/plain; name="attachment2.txt"; charset="ISO-8859-1"

VGhpcyBpcyBhIHRlc3QgYXR0YWNobWVudCB3aXRoIG5vbi1BU0NJSSBsaWtlIMK8Lgo=

--=-i7xTKF0wGtypzrrxHBJS--
```
